item.title: FAMU's new head coach builds first recruiting class with focus on academics and local talent
item.description: Coach Quinn Gray Sr. is focusing on academics and keeping local talent like Peter Warrick Award winner Jaylan Lurry at home.

item.title: The Festival of the Creative Arts takes on a weather theme for 2026
item.description: The "It's the Weather!" event will be held at the Challenger Learning Center this Saturday at the Challenger Learning Center as it kicks off the Festival of the Creative Arts.

item.title: Local organization delivers groceries to Gadsden County families impacted by ICE
item.description: Members with United Voices of Gadsden say recent immigration enforcement has made some Gadsden County families afraid to leave their homes. The group is now delivering groceries to help the families.
